title: Advertising and Marketing Basics
scope_note: FTC business guidance. It is not a substitute for category-specific statutes, rules, or legal advice.

sections.heading: Truth, fairness, and evidence
sections.text: Under the law, claims in advertisements must be truthful, cannot be deceptive or unfair, and must be evidence-based. For some specialized products or services, additional rules may apply.

sections.heading: Additional rules for specialized products
sections.text: For some specialized products or services, additional rules may apply. Businesses should identify category-specific requirements in addition to the general truth-in-advertising standards.
